inputs.name: openwebui_version
inputs.description: Tag of the ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui image, such as "v0.12.5". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for openwebui_version, such as "sha256:0344...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address Open WebUI listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: admin_email
inputs.description: Email of the first admin account, which Open WebUI creates at startup when it has no users yet. Set it with admin_password.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password of the first admin account. It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: admin_name
inputs.description: Display name of the first admin account.

inputs.name: enable_signup
inputs.description: Let people create their own accounts from the sign-in page. New accounts get default_user_role.

inputs.name: default_user_role
inputs.description: Role of an account someone creates for themselves: "pending" waits for an admin to approve it, "user" can chat straight away.

inputs.name: share_models_with_all_users
inputs.description: Show every model to every user. When false, a user sees only the models an admin has given them, or their group, access to.

inputs.name: ollama_base_url
inputs.description: Address of the Ollama server, such as circuit-ollama's default "http://127.0.0.1:11434". When null, Open WebUI's Ollama connection is turned off.

inputs.name: ollama_models
inputs.description: Ollama models Open WebUI offers, by full name and tag, such as ["qwen2.5:0.5b"]. When empty, every model Ollama has.

inputs.name: openai_base_url
inputs.description: Address of an OpenAI-compatible API, such as a LiteLLM gateway at "http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1". When null, the OpenAI connection is turned off.

inputs.name: openai_api_key
inputs.description: API key for openai_base_url. It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: openai_models
inputs.description: Model IDs Open WebUI offers from openai_base_url, such as ["gpt-4o-mini"]. Open WebUI lists exactly these without asking the server. When empty, whatever the server lists.

inputs.name: database_url
inputs.description: PostgreSQL connection URL, such as "postgresql://openwebui:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:5432/openwebui". When null, Open WebUI uses SQLite in its volume. It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: persistent_config
inputs.description: Let settings changed in the admin panel outlive a restart. When false, every start takes them from this circuit again.

inputs.name: offline_mode
inputs.description: Set Open WebUI's OFFLINE_MODE: no model downloads from Hugging Face, no version checks and no pip installs for tools. The image already holds the default embedding and speech models.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: More of Open WebUI's environment variables, such as { WEBUI_URL = "https://chat.example.com", ENABLE_ADMIN_CHAT_ACCESS = "false" }. They go in the same root-only file as the passwords and never reach the plan or state.
